items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Freddie Green. Yeah. [INTERVIEWEE] He been with him for years. Years and years and years.

ctx.x: Ohhhh, Herschel Evans...Sammy Price...Ben Webster...oh, a whole lotta people. Some of them...he got one or two of them boys still workin' with 'im...workin' with all...workin' all this time...
Yeah, they ain't stopped. They been in...they with him a long time. The guitar player with Count Basie--he's there.
